skim.know_text: Don't know the device by name. Would assume Bernal based on general knowledge of device results.
skim.skim_impression: Measurements look reasonable but it looks very hard to make conclusions from those FFTs

final.overall_read: To me the device was clearly unideal from early on and operator input should have been requested. Anything done at field seemed like a waste of time as trying to extract anything from that data seemed like a waste of time
final.biggest_wrong: I think it needed some recognition of data quality of the FFT. I doubt a better measurement could have resolved this, but it seemed like Hera was too keen to provide an answer
